user.title: Connect to Homepage
user.description: Import your Homepage app links as native Home Assistant cards. No widget metrics are fetched. If HA needs a LAN address, set the optional internal API URL; the Homepage URL is still used for app links and the allowed Host header.

data_description.url: The full Homepage address you normally open in your browser.
data_description.api_url: Optional internal address and port reachable from HA. Leave blank to use the Homepage URL.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) base URL without credentials, query parameters, or fragments.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Homepage. Check the address, network access, and allowed hosts.
error.auth_required: Homepage requires authentication or redirects. Use an internal API URL accessible to HA; do not remove public authentication.
error.invalid_catalog: This address did not return a valid Homepage service catalog at /api/services.

abort.already_configured: This Homepage instance is already configured.

init.title: Catalog refresh
init.description: How often to check for added, renamed, or removed Homepage services.
